scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: npm run build -w web && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w server --if-present && npm run test -w web
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n server,web,electron -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w desktop"
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w desktop
scripts.pack:desktop: npm run build -w web && npm run pack:win -w desktop
